papers.title: An Experimental Investigation of the Shape Deviation of SLM Printed Parts
papers.abstract: The 3D printing technology is increasingly used in manufacturing, medicine, education, and various other fields. This technology allows for the creation of parts with complex shapes, which would be difficult or even impossible to manufacture using traditional machining methods. However, the quality of the printed products is still a barrier to the widespread use of the 3D printing technology in industrial applications. The former includes the accuracy of the shape, size, and mechanical properties of the printed products. Research to improve the efficiency of the printing process and the printed product quality is essential for application fields. This study, through experiments, determines the relationship between the shape deviation of the printed products and the set of printing parameters. The latter includes the laser power, printing speed, and printing layer thickness. Experimental studies were conducted on the FF-M180D printer using the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) printing method. Ti6Al4V powder is utilized as printing material for this study. Based on the regression model showing the relationship between the printing parameters and shape deviation, the optimal set of parameters to minimize the shape deviation was determined.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM打印参数对形状偏差的影响，未涉及后处理对疲劳/力学性能的调控，与L2方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on as-built shape deviation from printing parameters, not on post-processing treatments (heat treatment, HIP, machining, etc.) that modify fatigue/mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM打印参数对Ti6Al4V零件形状偏差的影响，以提高打印质量。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量不同激光功率、速度和层厚下的形状偏差，建立回归模型。
summary_zh.result: 确定了最优打印参数组合以最小化形状偏差。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量形状偏差，无力学性能验证。

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the effect of SLM printing parameters on shape deviation of Ti6Al4V parts to improve printing quality.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurements of shape deviation under varying laser power, speed, and layer thickness were used to build a regression model.
summary_en.result: The optimal set of parameters to minimize shape deviation was determined.
summary_en.validation: Shape deviation was experimentally measured, but no mechanical performance validation was performed.

papers.title: Torsional and axial tension/compression fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V diamond lattices produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF)
papers.abstract: The increasing importance to characterize additively manufactured lattice structures in different load regimes cannot be overemphasized due to their robust load bearing applications in lightweight structural parts or biomedical implants. This study investigates the torsional fatigue behavior of metallic diamond cell structures to check the mean stress sensitivity of these meta-materials. Consistency in results for torsional fatigue is achieved by a unique sample design that minimizes stress concentration, is self-centering and graded. In addition, axial fatigue in tension–tension, compression–compression and tension–compression is studied. The tensile mode is found to be most detrimental to fatigue life of all axial modes. An analytical local stress method (LSM) is presented to estimate the maximum local stresses that occur in the structure. By using this approach, axial tension/compression and torsion fatigue experiments almost fall together due to the similar maximum local stress. Reverse calculations from these local stress curves can provide valuable insight into torsional strength when data are available only for axial fatigue tests. • Unique sample design to provide consistent results under torsional loads. • Fatigue life normalization model for different relative density and load regimes. • Macro and micro-scale correlative fractographic analysis of lattices.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V点阵结构的扭转和轴向疲劳行为，属于L1层研究范围。
llm.why_not_core: 论文未涉及后处理（如HIP、热处理）对疲劳性能的影响，也未聚焦于植入物结构。

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF Ti-6Al-4V点阵结构在扭转和轴向载荷下的疲劳行为。
summary_zh.method: 独特试样设计实现扭转疲劳自定心，轴向疲劳含拉-拉、压-压、拉-压模式，并用局部应力法分析。
summary_zh.result: 拉伸是最有害的轴向模式；局部应力法使轴向和扭转疲劳数据归一化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扭转和轴向疲劳实验验证，辅以断口分析。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize torsional and axial fatigue behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V diamond lattices, which are critical for lightweight and biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: A self-centering, graded sample design minimized stress concentrations for torsional fatigue; axial fatigue tests were performed in tension-tension, compression-compression, and tension-compression; an analytical local stress method (LSM) estimated maximum local stresses.
summary_en.result: Tensile mode was most detrimental; LSM consolidated axial and torsional fatigue data onto a master curve based on local stress.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing with fractographic analysis validated the approach.
